title: Privacy Policy — Level Up Com
intro: Welcome to Level Up Com (“Level Up Com,” “we,” “our,” or “us”). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal and business information is handled securely and responsibly.
This Privacy Policy explains how Level Up Com collects, uses, stores, and protects your information when you use our platform and related services.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.lead: We may collect the following types of information:

groups.title: Personal Information
items: Full name
Email address
Phone number
Company name
Job title or business role (e.g., developer, landowner, buyer, broker)

groups.title: Business & Property Information
items: Land listing details
Property ownership information
Plot size, location, zoning, and related documents
Seller requirements and deal preferences
Bid and offer information submitted through the platform

groups.title: Technical Information
items: Device type and operating system
IP address
App usage data
Log and diagnostic information

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.lead: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide and operate the Level Up Com platform
Facilitate land listings, bids, and communications between parties
Verify listings and improve platform security
Respond to inquiries and provide support
Improve our services and user experience
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

sections.heading: 3. How We Share Information
sections.lead: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information only as needed to:
items: Connect relevant parties in a land transaction
Work with trusted service providers under confidentiality obligations
Comply with law, regulation, or legal process
Protect the rights, safety, and integrity of Level Up Com and our users

sections.heading: 4. Data Storage & Transfers
paragraphs: Your information may be stored and processed in the United Arab Emirates or other jurisdictions where our service providers operate. We take appropriate measures to protect your information in accordance with applicable laws.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect your information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain information for as long as necessary to provide our services, fulfill the purposes described in this policy, and meet legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or to object to certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: 8. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Our platform may contain links or integrations with third-party services. Those services are governed by their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their practices.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Level Up Com is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
Any changes will be posted on this page or through our official channels, with the updated effective date shown above.
Continued use of Level Up Com after changes means you accept the revised policy.
